steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: I'm going out. Would you like to come with?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Give me a moment.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Drei, zwei, eins...

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Frau Seemann, guten abend!

The window facing the street opens in response, and a woman with a furrowed brow holds a paintbrush, gazing into the distance. The young girl waves to her, smiling as bright as the marigolds lining the alley.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Frau Seemann takes a break and opens her window every day right at this time. She paints all morning, then looks into the distance, listens to music, relaxes, and looks for inspiration.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: That's odd, looks like she's in a bad mood today. She closed the window without waving back. Maybe she's having trouble with her art. I should go see her with Mutti tonight.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You know the neighborhood well, Vivian.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: You mean Karl Schmidt Street? Of course I do. I've been here all ten years of my life!

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Did your parents always live here?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: They were away for brief stints a few times, I'm not sure why... But they always came back.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: When you compare it to the rest of Zwillingstürme, Karl Schmidt isn't anything special. We've got a few flower shops, a bar, paint stores, and some stout buildings. We don't even have a spire.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: The people here are ordinary, plus a few struggling artists and nobles... but my parents really like it here.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Have they ever had any trouble?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Vati mentioned some trouble before. But he's been prepared for anything since he decided to stay.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Did Werner von Hochberg find a way to become common?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Vati's not so common! He may only teach literature at the commoners' school in Wein, but the big kids there respect him a lot.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: He probably used all his connections in Sturmland and Zwillingstürme, spent all his savings, maybe even changed his appearance...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's no small thing to give up everything one has.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: By the way, Vivian, is that a cake you're holding?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Ja, the lady next door taught me. The marigold's stamen has a bitterness to it, but when ground into powder and pinched into a cake, its fragrance helps balance the sweetness.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Mutti found a job in Bachshof, earning a bit more than before. She's working as an editor for her favorite poetry journal! She gets home very late though...

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: So I said I'd bring her lunch for a whole month.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Isn't that exhausting?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: Mmmm... you smell that?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: When the breeze picks up, the fragrance of the coffee shop up ahead wafts on over.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: I help with as much as I can so Mutti and Vati won't be so tired. At least enough that they can take me to Frau Seemann's gatherings on the weekends.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: They hold my hands as we walk down the long alley to her house. There are so many interesting people there. They play the piano so well, and speak so eloquently.

steps.name: Vivian
steps.text: I like it here. I don't think it's exhausting.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...I'm glad of that.

a.text: This is a wonderful life too.

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby A
steps.text: What's this? Wasn't that... Lucinda?

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby A
steps.text: How could such a well-behaved commoner have offended anyone? Did she write something she shouldn't have? Why did the authorities come so quickly? Is there any explanation?

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby B
steps.text: They were gone as quick as they came, what else can we say? (Whispering) Be careful what you ask. It probably has something to do with her husband.

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby A
steps.text: Werner?

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby B
steps.text: I've heard he's actually the heir to the Kurfürst of Sturmland, living incognito with his wife and daughter on Karl Schmidt Street for the past decade.

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby A
steps.text: I've gotten along with them so well all these years, I'd never have guessed. He's hidden himself so well...

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby B
steps.text: Oh, how could that be!

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby B
steps.text: Rumor has it Werner didn't show up to class this morning. Who knows if he was taken away by a Hochberg vassal or the Empresses' Voice?

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby B
steps.text: Odds are it was Frieda Seemann who gave him up. That woman's out of her mind.

steps.name: Onlooking Passerby A
steps.text: Shhh, keep your voice down.
The cake thuds as it falls to the ground.
Viviana hears sobbing. The fragile shoulders before her tremble, like flowers battered by the wind.
She holds the girl's hand tightly.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Vivian... Don't look.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Seniora Yulia Schüler, I perceive only vague silhouettes of the remnants. Could you clearly point out the locations where they may be hidden?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: My patron firearm may be of use. I will guarantee your safety.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Herr Executor, you may have misunderstood.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Those men aren't here to do anything to me.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: When I first saw the masked people, I would keep my distance and hide, but I later found they weren't concerned with me at all.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Their appearance in any particular part of 'Zwillingstürme' usually means there's a new threat... they're more like a 'signal.'

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: 'Threat'?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Not a true threat, I... I don't know how to explain it.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: It's like... a natural disaster beyond human comprehension, abnormally bad weather, or a waking nightmare...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: The atmosphere in 'Zwillingstürme' has taken a turn for the worse, especially recently. The clouds are heavy, and even the sunset looks faded. I'm always hearing loud, thundering noises.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Several times, I awoke to find a whole chunk of 'Zwillingstürme' completely empty.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: So many prominent buildings seemingly dug away by something, leaving only an empty space where they once were. Like a whole section of history had been erased.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: The threats erase the spires of different eras without a trace, gradually consuming all of 'Zwillingstürme.'

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: And sooner or later, the small alley I live in will be next.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: So you jumped out to prevent me from using my patron firearm.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You've been protecting this place.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Ja. I've never seen you before.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I've had a powerful premonition this time.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A premonition.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Such feelings are usually nothing more than psychological indicators. Without backing in logic, it is difficult to take action upon them.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: But the Witch King's remains have indeed appeared...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Herr Executor, when you live in a place for five or ten years, when you become a part of it, you develop senses like a fowlbeast, and can smell the storm before it comes.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You would aid the 'Echoes of Herkunftshorn'?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: No, this is my own thing. Even if they didn't appear today, I'd find a way myself.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But how will you fight against those disasters, the weather, or the waking nightmares?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: With those Arts devices you're carrying...?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: The truth is, I've been going to different places at around this time each day. Especially to those blanks and the edges where buildings have vanished.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: That's dangerous...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: But I collected enough devices from those places.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: They seem to be some sort of echo device that collects Arts information.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Frau Giallo, if the masked men truly are the Echoes of Herkunftshorn, then these echo devices must be what the Witch King used to deal with his enemies.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They'll surely come in handy!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Are you... going to renovate the street yourself?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Marigold Alley is on the outskirts of Bodenshof, very inconspicuous. No one comes here deliberately, except some tourists, painters, and wandering poets.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Even all of Bodenshof, taken against the twenty-two districts of Zwillingstürme, isn't all that special.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: And in this Zwillingstürme, with its many storied historical spires... maybe no one would even notice such an ordinary alley.

spans.text: Zwillingstürme, with its many storied historical spires... maybe no one would even notice such an ordinary alley.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: But it's where I was born and raised... No one knows it better than me.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I know when it's lively, and when it's quiet.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I know all its sounds: the singing of wandering troubadours, the humming tunes of pedestrians, the busy footsteps on the cobblestones, the sound of rain against the marigolds and awnings...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I know where the resonance pipelines buried beneath the street are still functional, I know which Arts sculptures on the corners can replace the broken parts...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: And how to connect them all in the most convenient way, and then activate them with these echo devices!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But you don't know what the modified resonance pipelines will even do.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: These devices left in those empty areas suggest that—

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Oh, but Frau Giallo, there's something I have to do.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: And I can always do something.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I told myself as much, when I was very young.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I said I'd take good care of Jan and myself. And not be like our parents...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Your parents?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They passed away a long time ago, I think it was 1077.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Your parents were persecuted during the Twin Empresses' coup?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Nein, they were as common as common could be.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They were sick at the time, and the tremendous sound of the Witch King's Genesis Spire collapsing in the distance, the tromping of the soldiers outside the house... it all aggravated their illness.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They always feared that, at any moment, the Gendarmerie would burst in and take us away, or even level the entire block. In turbulent times like that, there is nothing so shocking.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They died in terror even before Herr Bach could launch his Glorreiches Kapitalprojekt.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: When a terrible clamor drowns out everything else, we hear only the voices within ourselves. We find our fears and worries magnified.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Yulia, forgive me for not being able to better comfort you.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: That's alright. I just wanted to say that I can't let myself lose the courage to live as I have been.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Maybe you still don't see our surroundings clearly... We've walked all the way from the gallery at the end of the street down to the cafe where I've spent almost a decade.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I started working there just to make ends meet. The owner was kind, letting me and Jan live in the shed behind the courtyard.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I turned it into a proper home, and even set up a little space for Jan to practice his Arts.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: The boy is gifted, you know. We saw casters using Arts to repair sculptures on the street, and he watched for only a few moments before going home and spending the whole night turning his room into a 'sound-control' space.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I've talked about it with Loris, and we'll send him to study Arts at Ludwigs-Universität.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Loris intends to make a career in Zwillingstürme, and once he does, he'll give Jan a recommendation.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Later, when this cafe was about to close down, I used all my savings to buy it for myself.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I became the owner, the waitress, and even worked on making my own special blend of coffee for its grand reopening...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Danger is unpredictable, but life is tangible.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You only want to protect it.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: From the piano studio on the corner to here, there are a total of eight resonance pipelines, and these echo devices happen to fit the interfaces on them.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I told you they'd be useful!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That is logical.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Bach tuned all of Zwillingstürme's resonance pipelines during his Glorreiches Kapitalprojekt, in order to adjust the Arts arrays laid throughout the city during the reign of the Witch King.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: We're just a few steps from my cafe now. The reconstruction project for this half is almost done.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Are they showing up again?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Ja. Right around the corner from the cafe.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I guess I'll need to work faster.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: This feels... familiar.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Similar to a certain day, exactly the same even...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: It was the day I first opened the cafe. I stood by the door waiting for Loris and Jan... They were a little late.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I knew the two of them wanted to do something special for the grand opening. They were a little too obvious about it.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Loris went to order flowers in another part of the city, and specifically asked me to wait for him in the most conspicuous part of the block...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: He didn't even realize he'd left the order on the table when he came by to help the day before.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Meanwhile, Jan had snuck into Frau Seemann's house a few times the week before... Nearly all the kids of Marigold Alley have asked her to paint them a souvenir still life at one point or another.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I let them go anyway. The beginning of a new life... I promised Loris as much too.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: The wind was strong that morning. Enough to make you feel dazed. There weren't many people out on the street.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: But I think I noticed two standing in the corner opposite the cafe...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They had black masks... with twisted patterns on them...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: They noticed me too. They walked over.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The Witch King's remains... That explains why you perceive the patterns in the Genesis Horn as manifesting a concrete form.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This was your only connection to the Witch King during your lifetime.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Loris's speculation differed wildly from the truth. You just happened to be at the scene while the Witch King's remains were taking action...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The city council had no intent to protect a nobleman. As one involved in taking action against the remains, one can imagine Freiherr Fynn's ultimate fate.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: But early in the reign of the Twin Empresses, Zwillingstürme needed to disassociate the entire case from the Witch King and his remains.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: They halted the investigation, concealed the truth of the matter, and hastily closed the case. That was the most efficient approach.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Um, what do you mean?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yulia Schüler, your death was entirely coincidental.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I have uncovered the truth of the case. If recalling these details is a burden to you, please refrain from doing so.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Nein, Herr Executor, I only worry that this street may disappear from 'Zwillingstürme' at some point. Just like the long-gone spires...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: And that I'll never have the chance to keep my promise to Loris.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Logically speaking, you have already—

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Herr Executor, have you ever made any unfulfilled promises?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Since accepting my commission with the Notarial Hall, there have been two instances where the decedent's will was too ambiguous to be enforceable, and two instances where the target was inadvertently destroyed in an explosion. No other circumstances.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Oh, I don't mean at work.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A... 'promise.'

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Fede... What are you doing?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Drawing.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: In the dark?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It is not difficult.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I am busying myself... You said you needed quiet.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Gratias.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: What are you drawing?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Laterano. By night.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Why would you want to draw Laterano by night?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Because the room is dark.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Soror, the nasal tone of your voice has grown lighter. You've stopped crying.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You said you would gradually master your playing. I believe in you. Everyone says you have a talent for music. In general, talent should not bring pain.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I will master it, Fede... I have to.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Are you going to finish your drawing? You seem to be having trouble.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I've completed the overall outline. Now I need to refine the details. But... When night falls on Laterano, where is the first place to light up?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: How about you wait for me to master my method and play my first piece. It won't take long. Then I can take you to the highest point in Laterano to see for yourself.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: That would answer your question, wouldn't it?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: To me, a 'promise' is a form of contract.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: When I made that contract, my cognitive abilities were not yet fully developed, and I was unclear of the obstacles she faced. As well as the painful meaning behind overcoming those obstacles.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: An undefined chaos. She herself was the first 'victim' of her music.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Therefore, understanding the full extent of her changes and preventing her from continuing to spread chaos is the responsibility I must fulfill.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Herr Executor, is that why you've come to 'Zwillingstürme' too?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Is the person you're talking about also a Sankta?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Arturia, female, 168 centimeters tall, straight black hair, a mole below her left eye, carries a custom-made cello.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: She arrived here before I did. Have you seen her?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Frau Giallo, you may not want to follow me any further.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You just said that from the gallery at the end of the street to here, with your cafe just ahead, all the resonance pipelines here will soon be restored.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: What is it... you're keeping me from?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I believe he's the one who hurt you. He's a Sankta as well, yes, but he seems difficult to talk to.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Federico? So he's here too.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I appreciate your concern. But if it was my little brother who hurt me, you'd have found a few more bullet holes.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: So you're siblings? That's hard to imagine...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Federico will definitely catch up to me.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The discovery of gaps along the path one's been following inevitably causes confusion. But for him, that confusion isn't a ripple, it's a crack in the ice.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Neither of us can stop until we find answers.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Phew... This is the last bit... The piano studio on the corner, the gallery at the end of the street... The beginning and the end, all the resonance pipelines converge here.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Yulia...

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I know what you want to say. This might not have any effect at all... And if so, I'll think of another way.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: I can't let myself just hide away in my home, waiting for the storm to pass.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: The echo devices are all in place. Now it's time to activate the resonance pipelines.
Without direction, without daylight, everything is covered in shadow. The Genesis Horn seems to be forever shrouded in mist.
But Arturia perceives the illumination of the pipelines, like a flame in the dark.

Rolling out from the two of them, from near to far, the surrounding scenery gradually becomes clear. She sees everything as clearly as in Yulia's eyes: a street lined with marigolds, countless peculiar spires...
The place is not chaotic. It is one that exists beyond time and space, a grand construct.
At the same time, music flows into her ears.
It is the music of all Marigold Alley, and also, a part of a grander movement. A composition that belongs to Herkunftshorn.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Yulia, my cello is silent, but I've heard your innermost thoughts... they're touching.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Allow me to express my gratitude.
Arturia bows to the Caprinae before her.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So, the most common soul and the most powerful are both written on the same sheet of music.
The eerie winged sculptures prostrate on both sides of Arturia, supporting towering stone pillars at angles defying mechanical explanation... No, the pillars are suspended in midair.
A palace, solemn and majestic, befits a king.
At the end of the steps, a man stands motionless with his throne. Red curtains sway and cast layers of light on him, veiling the monarch's countenance.
But the infamous twisted horns belie his name.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I've seen you in so many fragments of history and legend. I've crossed paths with you in the memories of so many, including the Liches.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But it wasn't until I saw Yulia still 'alive' that I caught the faint sense that this journey could really lead to a meeting with the man himself!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Allow me to introduce myself: Arturia Giallo.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Salutations, Otto Dietmar Gustav von Urtica, Herkunftshorn... Your Majesty the Witch King.
